mapper.select: SELECT b.name AS body_part_name, e.name AS exercise_name, t.training_id, t.weight, t.reps FROM trainings t LEFT JOIN exercises e ON t.exercise_id = e.exercise_id LEFT JOIN body_parts b ON e.parts_id = b.parts_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.date = #{date} ORDER BY b.name, e.name
SELECT t.training_id, t.date, e.parts_id, e.exercise_id, t.weight, t.reps FROM trainings t LEFT JOIN exercises e ON t.exercise_id = e.exercise_id WHERE t.training_id = #{trainingId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trainings(date, user_id, exercise_id, weight, reps) VALUES(#{date}, #{userId}, #{exerciseId}, #{weight}, #{reps})
mapper.update: UPDATE trainings SET date = #{date}, exercise_id = #{exerciseId}, weight = #{weight}, reps = #{reps} WHERE training_id = #{trainingId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM trainings WHERE training_id = #{trainingId} AND user_id = #{userId}
